title: Marlowe Rewards Birthday Tenure Gift Schedule
content:
A membership-tenure gift is added to a Marlowe Rewards birthday bonus. Its size depends on the whole calendar months from the enrolment date to the claim date.

| Whole calendar months from enrolment to the claim date | Membership-tenure gift |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 150 points |
| 12 to 59 | 50 points |
| under 12 | none |

The gift is a flat number of points added to the birthday bonus. Where the tier held carries no birthday points, no birthday bonus is posted and no gift is added.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical member enrolled 5 June 2020)

| Claim date | Whole calendar months | Gift |
|---|---|---|
| 5 June 2025 | 60 | 150 points |
| 4 June 2025 | 59 | 50 points |

For a member enrolled 5 June 2024:

| Claim date | Whole calendar months | Gift |
|---|---|---|
| 5 June 2025 | 12 | 50 points |
| 4 June 2025 | 11 | none |
